name: First Day Of The Seven Month
overview: The first day of the seventh month holds significant spiritual importance as seen in Nehemiah 8:2, where Ezra the priest publicly read the Law to the people who understood its meaning, marking a moment of covenant renewal and teaching. Haggai 2:19 highlights this day as a turning point of divine blessing, signaling God's promise to prosper His people despite current lack of fruitfulness. John 4:14 points beyond the Old Testament observance to Christ’s offer of living water that satisfies eternally, connecting the physical calendar event to the spiritual life and hope found in Jesus.
